data.desc: Founded in 2014, Faraday Future (FF) is a U.S.-based Physical AI ecosystem company dedicated to merging the future of robotics and mobility solutions through AI innovation and technologies. Following the completion of the transfer of its robotics business to FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. (FFR), Faraday Future is upgrading into a Robotaxi and EAI Cabin (Intelligent cabin) shared mobility operations company and a Physical AI investment holding company. Evolving its automotive business from an EV manufacturer to a Robotaxi Sharing Network and AI Visicabin technology operator. FF aims to advance its 'Four Future Trends' concept, once again helping to drive automotive-industry transformation.
